description: Type text on the real keyboard into the focused field (CoreDevice or idb on the iOS Simulator, adb on Android). Tap the field first (tap_element or native_tap). Unlike tap_element's text, this goes through the keyboard like a person typing. It types plain ASCII only (letters, digits, punctuation, newlines).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

text.description: The text to type. Write {{secret:NAME}} for a password: Buoy types BUOY_SECRET_NAME from its environment and hides it in what it returns. Prefer real password fields (shown as dots).

name: native_type
